name: @contractor/native-faultmatrix
description: Transaction and network fault-boundary matrix (M03-T09): automated scenarios across local commit, server acceptance, feed delivery, checkpoint persistence, attachment transfer, and device recovery. Durability evidence runs against REAL SQLite (node:sqlite, incl. SIGKILL child processes and max_page_count disk-full) and DISPOSABLE PostgreSQL (CI services: postgres:16, pinned pg client); mocks may supplement but never substitute. Emits a reproducible markdown matrix report with sanitized identifiers and deterministic recovery actions.
